description: Speech to text: turn a voice note, phone call, meeting recording, podcast clip or video (mp3, m4a, wav, ogg, mp4, webm, up to 15 minutes) into text with timestamps, using Whisper. Language is detected automatically. Use when you need the words, a summary or quotes from audio or video. Send {url} or {base64}, optional language (2-letter code). Returns {language, duration, text, segments}. Errors: 413 over 15 minutes, 422 not audio. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402).

base64.description: File contents, base64-encoded (max 20 MB). Provide url OR base64.

url.description: Public URL of the file. Provide url OR base64.

name: transcribe_audio
title: Audio to text transcription
